caveats: The corpus contains ten paired mutation patterns across two synthetic source documents; it is not twenty independent source scenarios.
The maintained genealogy detector is eligible only for the rendered seven-column family cases; maintenance-card cases are out of domain for that baseline.
The generic structural-only baseline cannot establish source-semantic correctness and must be reported separately from the maintained detector and model arms.
Uncertain cases intentionally test missing or ambiguous source attribution; explicit uncertain output must remain review-routed regardless of confidence.
Results support a bounded relative comparison on this closed five-class vocabulary, not a claim of general document-consistency performance.
